eligibility_basis: Individual instruction/input-only manual review with one benign reason per prepared ID; no model outputs or target sequences used. Entire-source keyword screening is metadata only and never approves a case.

dataset.license_note: Repository MIT and public release do not resolve instance-level terms; retained as provenance qualification, not rewritten.

reference_protection: Only instruction/input in native user prompt; one fixed system format instruction. Source sequences reside only in source acquisition/scorer files, never requests. No sequence contents printed during preparation.

source_contract.source_prompt: DataCollatorForMolinstNI -> Prompter.generate_prompt(instance instruction, instance input); output is only label, not prompt
source_contract.native_decoding: train_utils.predict decodes outputs/labels/inputs using tokenizer_pred, skip_special_tokens=True and cleanup_tokenization_spaces=True, then strip. Protein-added tokens recreated nonspecial in tokenizer_pred. Decoded (target,input) pairs enter molinst_pro_understand; no protein-string cleanup there.
source_contract.metric_wiring: Pro_understand._compute computes references_new for TSV but passes original target/input pairs to rouge.compute; returns rougeL.

metric_contract.native_wrapper_method: Pro_understand._compute; exact source AST method, no change to reference-pair wiring
metric_contract.reference_policy: [full original serialized target, full original Alpaca user prompt] per case; input remains an alternate reference
metric_contract.hf_method: Rouge._compute executed verbatim with rouge-score0.1.2; replace only unpinned network evaluate.load resolution
metric_contract.tokenizer: Default ASCII-alphanumeric lowercasing tokenizer, use_stemmer=False; this is lexical, not residue-alignment scoring
metric_contract.aggregation: HF/Google BootstrapAggregator defaults,1000 resamples; median(mid).fmeasure; fixed numpy seed42
metric_contract.multi_reference_behavior: Per ROUGE type, source score_multi chooses greatest F-measure among target and input references
metric_contract.output_processing: Raw returned final content; no parsing, whitespace cleanup, target-assisted repair, regeneration or favorable metric choice
metric_contract.missing_slot_policy: Empty prediction for all missing/failed planned subset slots; full59-slot denominator retained
metric_contract.invalid_truncation_policy: Retain and score raw malformed or length-stopped content; separate serialization diagnostics

comparison_qualification: Partial59-case zero-shot Qwen text baseline. Same released paired-reference ROUGE algorithm, prospectively pinned cached HF revision; full raw prompt/target serialization and added output-format system instruction differ from trained BioT5+ tokenizer,512/256 caps and greedy generation. Historical evaluate.load resolution unpinned. Not paper normalized Smith-Waterman, not design-function success, not full5876-case completion.

paper_metric.details: Paper reports selected examples, normalized Smith-Waterman and a manual terminal-repeat truncation practice. Exact substitution/gap parameters, normalization, full cohort and failure handling remain unrecovered; no replacement default or manual cleanup invented.

scoring_limits: Lexical overlap of serialized sequence tokens is not residue alignment or measured protein function.
Input remains an alternate reference by source code; an input echo can achieve perfect source ROUGE.
